_comment: 投資想法與查核點。早報事件判斷層每天讀這份（https://research.investmquest.com/ideas/ideas.json），把判成新事實的新聞比對到查核點，再問 Jev 支持／推翻／無關，結果寫到 /briefing/data/idea_hits.json。companies 用早報 evidence_routing 的公司代號，對照表認不得的公司另列英文名在 company_names；keywords 是英文新聞裡的辨識詞（小寫比對）；supports_if／refutes_if 是給 Jev 的英文判準，要寫成新聞字面上看得出來的事。

ideas.title: AI 剪刀差：token 越來越便宜，算力、電力、記憶體越來越貴

checkpoints.label: token 總用量的增速，跑贏降價幅度
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports AI token usage or inference volume growing strongly (for example monthly or weekly tokens processed rising sharply).
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports AI token usage or inference volume flattening, slowing, or declining.

checkpoints.label: GPU 雲租金持平或上漲，而且長約也跟著漲
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports GPU cloud rental prices or compute contract prices rising or holding firm, or customers signing new capacity at higher prices.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports GPU cloud rental prices or compute contract prices falling, discounting, or excess GPU capacity.

checkpoints.label: 記憶體（HBM 與一般 DRAM）價格續漲，2027 年長約上調
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports DRAM or HBM prices rising, memory shortage, or higher long-term memory contract prices.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports DRAM or HBM prices falling, spot prices dropping toward contract prices, or memory oversupply.

checkpoints.label: 發電與電網設備交期繼續拉長
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports power equipment (turbines, transformers, grid gear) backlogs growing, lead times lengthening, or data center projects delayed by power or grid access.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports power equipment lead times shortening, backlogs shrinking, or order cancellations.

checkpoints.label: 四大雲廠資本支出上修
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports a hyperscaler raising or maintaining high AI or data center capital spending plans.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports a hyperscaler cutting, pausing, or slowing AI or data center capital spending.

checkpoints.label: 資料中心融資還借得到錢
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports data center or AI cloud financing being raised successfully, loans trading near par, or IPOs well received.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports data center or AI cloud loans trading at a discount, credit downgrades, financing pulled, IPOs delayed, or projects mothballed.

checkpoints.label: 伺服器 CPU 缺貨、漲價守得住
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports server CPU demand exceeding supply, server CPU price increases, or strong data center CPU revenue growth.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports server CPU price cuts, excess CPU inventory, or slowing data center CPU sales.

checkpoints.label: 台積電營收與先進封裝產能
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports TSMC revenue growing strongly, wafer price increases, or advanced packaging demand exceeding capacity.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports TSMC revenue slowing, order cuts, or advanced packaging capacity expanding fast enough that AI chips are no longer scarce.

checkpoints.label: 伺服器出貨量（信驊、緯穎、廣達月營收）
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports server shipments or server-related monthly revenue growing faster.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports server shipments or server-related monthly revenue slowing or declining.
